rules: The exam is taken in Finnish or Swedish. On first mention in a Thai text, an institution, office, document or procedure marked keepFinnish is followed by the Finnish word in parentheses: «รัฐสภาฟินแลนด์ (eduskunta)».
Use the rendering in 'th' for every occurrence; do not swap in a synonym.
Use polite, plain modern Thai (about B1 level) addressed to the reader with คุณ; avoid royal or very formal legal vocabulary where a common word works.
Dates as 6.12.1917 or «6 ธันวาคม 1917» in the Western calendar (not the Buddhist era); Arabic numerals; euros as in Finnish (5 €, 112); keep names of services (Kela, OmaVero, Suomi.fi) unchanged.
Do not add facts, advice or hedging that the Finnish text does not contain.
